description: This file defines the structure and functions related to 'elementNode' in the RBUS (RDK Bus) framework, including mutex management, element insertion/removal, subscriptions, and property handling.

classes.name: elementNode
classes.description: Represents an element node in the RBUS framework, including its name, hierarchy pointers, type, callback table, subscriptions, alias, change components, last change time, and a mutex for thread safety.

methods.name: getEmptyElementNode
methods.description: Creates and returns a new, empty elementNode structure.

methods.name: freeElementNode
methods.description: Frees memory associated with an elementNode.

methods.name: insertElement
methods.description: Inserts a new element into the RBUS element hierarchy under the specified root.

methods.name: removeElement
methods.description: Removes a specified elementNode from the hierarchy and frees its resources.

methods.name: retrieveElement
methods.description: Retrieves an elementNode by name from the hierarchy.

methods.name: retrieveInstanceElement
methods.description: Retrieves an instance element by name.

methods.name: retrieveInstanceElementEx
methods.description: Extended version to retrieve an instance element with synchronization options.

methods.name: printRegisteredElements
methods.description: Prints the structure of registered elements for debugging.

methods.name: fprintRegisteredElements
methods.description: Prints registered elements to a specified FILE stream.

methods.name: addElementSubscription
methods.description: Adds a subscription to an element node.

methods.name: removeElementSubscription
methods.description: Removes a subscription from an element node.

methods.name: elementHasAutoPubSubscriptions
methods.description: Checks if the element has auto-publish subscriptions, optionally excluding a certain subscription.

methods.name: addInstanceToElement
methods.description: Adds an instance number and optional alias to an element.

methods.name: instantiateTableRow
methods.description: Creates a new table row element under a table node.

methods.name: getPropertyInstanceNames
methods.description: Retrieves property instance names matching a query.

methods.name: setPropertyChangeComponent
methods.description: Sets the component name responsible for property changes.

methods.name: rbusElement_mutex_destroy
methods.description: Destroys all mutexes associated with element nodes, ensuring cleanup.

ctags.name: cbTable
ctags.pattern: /^    rbusElementCallbackTable_t cbTable;     \/* Callback table for the element *\/$/

ctags.name: changeComp
ctags.pattern: /^    char*                   changeComp;     \/* For properties, the last component to set the va/

ctags.name: changeTime
ctags.pattern: /^    rtTime_t                changeTime;     \/* For properties, the time the value was last set*/

ctags.name: elmMutex
ctags.pattern: /^    pthread_mutex_t         elmMutex;       \/* To protect if there is a direct\/private connect/

ctags.name: fullName
ctags.pattern: /^    char*                   fullName;       \/* full name\/path of element *\/$/

ctags.name: name
ctags.pattern: /^    char*                   name;           \/* relative name of element *\/$/

ctags.name: subscriptions
ctags.pattern: /^    rtList                  subscriptions;  \/* The list of rbusSubscription_t to this element */
